name: Orient a model using the viewport control

elements.name: Animate a change between orientation-control views

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with the block visible in an oblique view
animated view transitions are enabled
the user selects the Top face of the orientation control
the camera moves through visible intermediate orientations toward the Top view
the model view and orientation control update consistently during the transition
the camera settles with the block shown from the Top
the active document and model geometry remain unchanged

elements.name: View the top of a part and return to the home view

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
its home view shows the block isometrically
the viewport orientation control is visible
the user selects the Top face of the orientation control
the viewport shows the top of the block face-on as a rectangle
the orientation control displays Top
the same part and model browser remain active
the user selects the orientation control's Home action
the viewport returns to the block's isometric home view
the same part and model browser remain active

elements.name: Step between adjacent orthogonal views

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the orientation control displays the Front view
the user selects the right-side navigation arrow beside the orientation control
the control displays Right
the block is displayed face-on from the right
the user selects the left-side navigation arrow
the control displays Front
the block returns to the face-on front view
the same part and model browser remain active

elements.name: Show the Front label without a diagonal stroke across the orientation face

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the viewport orientation control displays the Front view
the user inspects the visible orientation face
the square face is labeled FRONT in uppercase
no diagonal stroke crosses the face
the block and model browser remain visible

elements.name: Display the axis triad at the lower-left of the viewport

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the viewport orientation control displays the Front view
the user inspects the viewport corners
an axis triad appears at the lower-left of the viewport
the X axis points right and is red
the Y axis points up and is green
the Z axis is indicated in blue at the triad origin
the orientation control remains at the upper-right of the viewport
the block remains visible

elements.name: Rotate and restore a face-on view

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the orientation control displays Front with its label upright
the block's front face is wider than it is tall on screen
the user selects the upper curved rotation arrow on the orientation control
the control still displays Front with its label rotated by a quarter turn
the block's front face is taller than it is wide on screen
the user selects the other curved rotation arrow
the Front label is upright again
the block's front face is wider than it is tall again
the same part and model browser remain active

elements.name: Choose a corner from a face-on view

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the orientation control displays an upright Front view
the user selects the upper-right corner of the orientation control
the block is displayed obliquely with its top, front and right faces visible
the orientation control shows the Top, Front and Right faces
the same part and model browser remain active

elements.name: Cancel a compass preference change

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control is visible in the viewport
its compass preference is off
the user opens the orientation control context menu and chooses Options
the options dialog displays controls for position, size and inactive opacity
it displays view transition and orientation settings
the compass option is unchecked and the north angle field is unavailable
the user enables the compass option
the north angle field becomes available
the user cancels the options dialog and reopens it
the compass option is unchecked
the north angle field is unavailable

elements.name: Move the orientation control to the opposite upper corner

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control and navigation bar are at the upper right of the viewport
the user opens the orientation control options
the user opens the on-screen position list
the list offers Top Right, Bottom Right, Top Left and Bottom Left
the user chooses Top Left and confirms the options
the orientation control appears at the upper left of the viewport
the navigation bar appears on the left side of the viewport
the part remains in its existing view
the user reopens the options
the on-screen position displays Top Left
the user chooses Top Right and confirms
the orientation control and navigation bar return to the right side
the same part and model browser remain active

elements.name: Change and restore the orientation control size

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control is visible with its size set to Automatic
the user opens the orientation control options and expands the size list
the list offers Automatic, Tiny, Small, Normal and Large
the user chooses Large and confirms the options
the orientation control is visibly larger in the viewport
the part remains in its existing view
the user reopens the options
the size displays Large
the user chooses Automatic and confirms
the orientation control returns to its earlier size in this viewport
the same part and model browser remain active

elements.name: Adjust the inactive opacity of the orientation control

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control has 50 percent inactive opacity
the user opens the orientation control options and expands the inactive opacity list
the list offers 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100 percent
the user chooses 100 percent and confirms the options
the user moves the pointer away from the orientation control
the inactive control appears more opaque than at 50 percent
the part remains in its existing view
the user reopens the options, chooses 50 percent and confirms
the user moves the pointer away from the control
the control returns to its earlier translucent appearance
the same part remains active

elements.name: Switch between orthographic and perspective projection

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
the block is displayed obliquely in Orthographic projection
the user opens the orientation control context menu
Orthographic is marked as the current projection
Perspective and Perspective with Ortho Faces are offered
the user chooses Perspective
the block remains visible in an oblique view with a changed projection
the same part and model browser remain active
the user reopens the orientation control context menu
Perspective is marked as the current projection
the user chooses Orthographic
the block returns to its orthographic appearance
the same part remains active

elements.name: Retain hybrid projection when selecting a named face

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
it is displayed obliquely in Orthographic projection
the user chooses Perspective with Ortho Faces from the orientation control menu
the block remains visible in an oblique view with a changed projection
the user selects Top on the orientation control
the block is displayed face-on from the top
the orientation control displays Top
the user reopens the orientation control menu
Perspective with Ortho Faces is marked as the current mode
the user chooses Orthographic
the same part remains active in the top view

elements.name: Show and hide the orientation compass

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with its Top view displayed
the orientation compass is disabled
the user opens the orientation control options
the user enables the compass and confirms the options
a compass with north, east, south and west indicators appears around the orientation control
the part remains in the Top view
the user reopens the orientation control options
the compass option is checked and its north angle field is available
the user disables the compass and confirms the options
the compass disappears
the orientation control and the same part remain visible

elements.name: Enable and select the orientation control visibility scope

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control options are open
showing the orientation control on window creation is enabled
Only in Current View is selected
the user clears the show-on-window-creation option
the All 3D Views and Only in Current View choices are unavailable
the position, size and inactive opacity controls remain available
the user enables the show-on-window-creation option
both visibility scope choices are available
Only in Current View remains selected
the user selects All 3D Views
All 3D Views is selected and Only in Current View is cleared
the user selects Only in Current View
Only in Current View is selected and All 3D Views is cleared
the user cancels the options
the options close and the part view remains displayed

elements.name: Select the current top plane as the front plane and cancel

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control options are open
the Front View Plane is XY(+Z) and the Top View Plane is XZ(+Y)
the user opens the Front View Plane list
it offers XY(+Z), XY(-Z), XZ(+Y), XZ(-Y), YZ(+X) and YZ(-X)
the user selects XZ(+Y) as the Front View Plane
the Front View Plane displays XZ(+Y)
the Top View Plane displays XY(+Z)
the user cancels the options and reopens them
the Front View Plane displays XY(+Z)
the Top View Plane displays XZ(+Y)

elements.name: Set and restore the compass north angle

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software in Top view
the compass is disabled and its north angle is 0 degrees
the user opens the orientation control options
the user enables the compass and enters 90 degrees as the north angle
the user confirms the options
the compass is visible around the orientation control
its north indicator appears to the right of the Top face
the block remains in Top view
the user reopens the orientation control options
the compass is enabled and the north angle is 90 degrees
the user changes the north angle to 0 degrees and confirms
the user selects Top on the orientation control
the compass north indicator appears above the Top face
the user disables the compass in the orientation control options and confirms
the compass is hidden and the block remains visible

elements.name: Fit the model when changing orientation

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software in Top view
fit to view on orientation change is enabled
the block is magnified until its face extends beyond the viewport
the user uses the orientation control to change to Front view
the whole block is visible within the viewport
the user disables fit to view on orientation change in the orientation control options
the user magnifies the Front view until the block extends beyond the viewport
the user uses the orientation control to change to Top view
the block remains magnified beyond the viewport
the user re-enables fit to view on orientation change
the user uses the orientation control to change to Front view
the whole block is visible within the viewport

elements.name: Rotate the Front view with keep model upright enabled

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software in upright Front view
the orientation control option to keep the model upright is disabled
the user enables keep model upright and confirms the options
the user selects the upper curved rotation arrow on the orientation control
the Front view and its label rotate by a quarter turn in the screen plane
the rectangular block remains visible
the user reopens the orientation control options
keep model upright is checked
the user clears keep model upright and confirms the options
the active part remains visible

elements.name: Place the orientation control in the lower viewport corners

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control is in the Top Right position
the user sets the orientation control position to Bottom Right and confirms
the orientation control appears near the lower-right viewport corner
the navigation bar appears above it on the right
the part view remains visible
the user reopens the orientation control options
the position is Bottom Right
the user sets the position to Bottom Left and confirms
the orientation control appears near the lower-left viewport corner
the navigation bar appears above it on the left
the part view remains visible
the user restores the position to Top Right and confirms
the orientation control and navigation bar return to the right side

elements.name: Toggle orientation lock for a selected face

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active with its rectangular block visible in the MCAD Software
no model geometry is selected
the user opens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is unavailable
the user closes the menu and selects a visible face of the block
the user opens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is available
the user chooses Lock to Current Selection
a lock indicator appears beside the orientation control
the user reopens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is checked
the user chooses Lock to Current Selection again
the lock indicator disappears
the user clears the face selection and reopens the orientation control context menu
Lock to Current Selection is unavailable

elements.name: Inspect view-definition choices without applying them

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the user opens the orientation control context menu
the user expands Set Current View as
the submenu offers Top and Front
the user expands Set Current View as Home
the submenu offers Fixed Distance and Fit to View
the user presses Escape without choosing a submenu action
the menus close and the same part view remains visible

elements.name: Reduce the orientation control to Tiny size

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software
the orientation control size is Automatic
the user sets the orientation control size to Tiny and confirms
the orientation control is visibly smaller in the same viewport
the part view remains visible
the user reopens the orientation control options
the size is Tiny
the user sets the size to Automatic and confirms
the orientation control returns to its earlier apparent size
the same part view remains visible
